_note: 孩子端用語：goal = 一句話講完今天要學會什麼（取代 communicativeGoalZh 的教學術語）；formZh = 用中文講的句型規則（取代 form 的英文文法術語，如 subject + predicate）。依 LESSON_PAGE_SPEC.md 第 1 節，資料庫欄位是給教學引擎用的，不可直接呈現給孩子。

F0.1-complete-sentence.goal: 看出一句話有沒有說完整
F0.1-complete-sentence.formZh: 「誰」＋「做什麼／是什麼」，兩個都要有才算一句話

speak.zh: 用完整的一句話，說一件關於家人的事
speak.eg: My sister is a student.

write.zh: 用完整的一句話，寫你的教室
write.eg: My classroom is very big.

F0.2-be-agreement.goal: 說「是」的時候，用對 am / is / are
F0.2-be-agreement.formZh: I 配 am；他、她、它 配 is；你、我們、他們 配 are

speak.zh: 說一句用 I am 開頭的話
speak.eg: I am ready for school.

write.zh: 寫一句主詞是好幾個人、要用 are 的話
write.eg: My friends are in the park.

F0.3-be-meaning.goal: 用「是」說出某人是誰、心情怎樣、在哪裡
F0.3-be-meaning.formZh: 誰 ＋ am/is/are ＋ 身分／心情／地點

speak.zh: 說出你的書包在哪裡
speak.eg: My school bag is under the desk.

write.zh: 寫一句今天心情怎麼樣
write.eg: I am happy today.

F0.4-singular-plural.goal: 說清楚是「一個」還是「很多個」
F0.4-singular-plural.formZh: 一個用原形；兩個以上字尾多半加 -s

speak.zh: 說一句有數字、也有兩個以上東西的話
speak.eg: I have three books.

write.zh: 用 box 和 child 的複數各寫一句
write.eg: There are two boxes. The children are playing.

F0.5-a-an-sound.goal: 決定要用 a 還是 an
F0.5-a-an-sound.formZh: 聽下一個字的開頭「聲音」：子音用 a，母音用 an（不是看字母）

speak.zh: 說一個用 a 的詞，再說一個用 an 的詞
speak.eg: a cat and an apple

write.zh: 寫一句用到 an hour 的話
write.eg: We waited for an hour.

F1.1-subject-pronouns.goal: 用「他、她、它、他們」代替一直重複的名字
F1.1-subject-pronouns.formZh: 把主角換成 I / you / he / she / it / we / they

speak.zh: 用 he 或 she 介紹一個人
speak.eg: She is my teacher.

write.zh: 寫一句用 they 講兩個人的話
write.eg: They are my classmates.

F1.2-action-affirmative.formZh: 誰 ＋ 做什麼 ＋ 對象／地點／時間

speak.zh: 說一件你每天都會做的事
speak.eg: I brush my teeth every morning.

write.zh: 寫一句有「誰＋做什麼＋對象」的話
write.eg: My brother plays the piano.

F1.3-predicate-choice.goal: 決定這句該用 be 還是一般動詞
F1.3-predicate-choice.formZh: 講身分／心情／地點用 be；講動作用一般動詞

speak.zh: 先說一句用 be 的話，再說一句講動作的話
speak.eg: I am hungry. I eat lunch at noon.

write.zh: 寫一句講狀態、一句講動作
write.eg: She is tired. She sleeps early.

F1.4-be-questions-negatives.goal: 用 be 問問題、說「不是」
F1.4-be-questions-negatives.formZh: 問句把 be 搬到最前面；否定在 be 後面加 not

speak.zh: 用 be 問句問別人心情怎麼樣
speak.eg: Are you happy today?

write.zh: 寫一句用 is not 或 are not 的否定句
write.eg: The door is not open.

F1.5-do-does.goal: 用 Do / Does 問問題、說「不」
F1.5-do-does.formZh: Do／Does 放句首，後面的動詞回到原形

speak.zh: 用 Do you...? 問朋友的日常習慣
speak.eg: Do you play basketball after school?

write.zh: 寫一句用 doesn't 的否定句
write.eg: He doesn't like carrots.

F1.6-wh-questions.goal: 問「誰、什麼、哪裡、什麼時候、為什麼、怎麼樣」
F1.6-wh-questions.formZh: 疑問詞放最前面，後面接 be 或 do／does

speak.zh: 用 where 問一個問題
speak.eg: Where is my pencil?

write.zh: 用 why 加 be 動詞寫一個問句
write.eg: Why are you late?

F2.1-present-simple.goal: 說平常、每天都會做的事
F2.1-present-simple.formZh: 一般用原形；主角是他／她／它時，動詞要加 -s

speak.zh: 說一件你每天都做的事
speak.eg: I walk to school every day.

write.zh: 寫一個關於動物的事實
write.eg: Cats sleep a lot.

F2.2-frequency-adverbs.goal: 把「總是、常常、有時候、從不」放在對的位置
F2.2-frequency-adverbs.formZh: 放在一般動詞前面；但要放在 be 動詞後面

speak.zh: 用 usually 說一句真的事
speak.eg: I usually get up at seven.

write.zh: 寫一句把 never 放對位置的話
write.eg: She never drinks coffee.

F2.3-present-continuous.goal: 告訴別人現在正在做什麼
F2.3-present-continuous.formZh: 誰 ＋ am/is/are ＋ 動詞加 ing（兩個都要，不能只有一個）

speak.zh: 說你現在正在做什麼
speak.eg: I am doing my homework.

write.zh: 寫一句別人正在做什麼
write.eg: My mom is cooking dinner.

F2.4-present-contrast.goal: 分清楚「平常都這樣」和「現在正在做」
F2.4-present-contrast.formZh: 平常的事用原形；此刻正在做的用 be ＋ 動詞加 ing

speak.zh: 比較你平常做的事，和今天正在做的事
speak.eg: I usually walk to school, but today I am taking the bus.

write.zh: 寫兩句：一句平常的、一句現在正在做的
write.eg: She reads every night. She is reading now.

F2.5-stative-verbs.goal: 知道有些字（喜歡、想要、知道）不能加 ing
F2.5-stative-verbs.formZh: like／want／know／need 這類表示狀態的字，直接用原形

speak.zh: 說一句用 know 或 need 的話
speak.eg: I know his name.

write.zh: 寫一句用「喜歡、想要」這類字的話
write.eg: She wants a new bike.

F2.6-pronoun-case.goal: 分清楚 I / me / my / mine 什麼時候用哪一個
F2.6-pronoun-case.formZh: 當主角用 I；被做的對象用 me；表示「誰的」用 my／mine

speak.zh: 說誰幫助你（用 me、him、her 這類字）
speak.eg: My father helps me.

write.zh: 寫一句用 my，一句用 mine
write.eg: This is my book. That one is mine.

F2.7-there-count-quantity.formZh: 一個用 There is；兩個以上用 There are

speak.zh: 說一樣你房間裡有的東西
speak.eg: There is a lamp on my desk.

write.zh: 用 There are 加數字寫一句
write.eg: There are four chairs in the room.

F3.1-past-be.formZh: I／他／她／它 用 was；你／我們／他們 用 were

speak.zh: 說你昨天在哪裡
speak.eg: I was at my grandma's house yesterday.

write.zh: 用 was 或 were 寫一個問過去的問句
write.eg: Were you at home last night?

F3.2-past-simple.goal: 說出昨天、剛才已經做過的事
F3.2-past-simple.formZh: 多數動詞加 -ed；有些要整個換掉（go → went）

speak.zh: 說一件你昨天做的事
speak.eg: I watched a movie yesterday.

write.zh: 寫兩句上週末做過的事
write.eg: We went to the beach. I ate ice cream.

F3.3-did-questions.formZh: Did 放句首，後面的動詞回到原形（不是過去式）

speak.zh: 用 Did 問一個關於昨天的問題
speak.eg: Did you finish your homework?

write.zh: 寫一句用 didn't 的過去否定句
write.eg: I didn't go to school yesterday.

F3.4-prepositions.goal: 說清楚東西在哪裡、事情在什麼時候
F3.4-prepositions.formZh: in／on／at 各自對應不同大小的地點和時間範圍

speak.zh: 說一樣東西在哪裡（用地點介系詞）
speak.eg: The cat is under the chair.

write.zh: 寫一句同時有時間和星期的話
write.eg: We have class at nine on Monday.

F3.5-connectors.goal: 把兩句話連起來：而且／但是／因為／所以
F3.5-connectors.formZh: 前一句 ＋ 連接詞 ＋ 後一句（同一組因果只用一個連接詞）

speak.zh: 用 because 把兩件事連起來
speak.eg: I am tired because I slept late.

write.zh: 用 but 寫一句有轉折的話
write.eg: The bag is small but heavy.

F3.6-basic-helpers.formZh: can／will／be going to 後面的動詞一律用原形

speak.zh: 說一件你會做的事
speak.eg: I can swim very well.

write.zh: 用 be going to 寫一個計畫
write.eg: I am going to visit my uncle.

F4.1-past-continuous.formZh: was／were ＋ 動詞加 ing；被打斷的那件事用 when 帶出來

speak.zh: 說昨天晚上八點你正在做什麼
speak.eg: I was reading a book at eight last night.

write.zh: 用 when 加過去進行式寫一句
write.eg: I was cooking when the phone rang.

F4.2-adjectives-adverbs.goal: 分清楚「形容東西」和「形容做事的樣子」
F4.2-adjectives-adverbs.formZh: 形容東西用形容詞；形容動作怎麼做，多半在字尾加 -ly

speak.zh: 描述某個人做事情的樣子
speak.eg: He runs very quickly.

write.zh: 寫一句用形容詞、一句用副詞
write.eg: It was a quiet room. She spoke quietly.

F4.3-comparatives.formZh: 兩個比：-er／more ⋯ than；最高級：the -est／the most

speak.zh: 比較你身邊的兩樣東西
speak.eg: This pencil is longer than that one.

write.zh: 寫一句最高級的話
write.eg: This is the tallest building in our city.

F4.4-quantifiers.goal: 說「很多」「一點點」的時候用對字
F4.4-quantifiers.formZh: 數得出來用 many／few；數不出來用 much／little

speak.zh: 用 how many 或 how much 問一個問題
speak.eg: How many books do you have?

write.zh: 用 a few 加可數名詞寫一句
write.eg: I have a few questions.

F4.5-modal-functions.formZh: should／must／have to／may／might 後面動詞一律用原形

speak.zh: 用 should 給一個建議
speak.eg: You should drink more water.

write.zh: 用 might 寫一件可能發生的事
write.eg: It might rain this afternoon.

F4.6-infinitive-gerund.goal: 在常用動詞後面，選對要接哪一種動詞形式
F4.6-infinitive-gerund.formZh: want／need／plan 後面接 to ＋ 原形；enjoy／finish 後面接 -ing

speak.zh: 說一件你喜歡做的事
speak.eg: I enjoy playing badminton.

write.zh: 寫一件你打算做的事
write.eg: I plan to study Japanese.

F5.1-present-perfect-experience.goal: 說出你「曾經做過」的事，或現在還看得到的結果
F5.1-present-perfect-experience.formZh: have／has ＋ 動詞的過去分詞（第三種變化）

speak.zh: 用 Have you ever...? 問別人的經驗
speak.eg: Have you ever been to Japan?

write.zh: 寫一件你曾經做過的事
write.eg: I have visited Taipei 101 twice.

F5.2-perfect-markers.goal: 說清楚「已經、還沒、從什麼時候開始、持續多久」
F5.2-perfect-markers.formZh: already 用在肯定句；yet 用在問句和否定句；since 接時間點；for 接一段時間

speak.zh: 說你學英文學多久了
speak.eg: I have studied English for three years.

write.zh: 寫一句用 already 或 yet 的話
write.eg: I have already finished my homework.

F5.3-perfect-vs-past.goal: 分清楚「事情已經過去了」和「到現在還有影響」
F5.3-perfect-vs-past.formZh: 有明確過去時間用過去式；講經驗或現在還看得到的結果用現在完成式

speak.zh: 比較一件已經結束的往事，和一個人生經驗
speak.eg: I went to Kenting last summer. I have never been to Hualien.

write.zh: 寫兩句，一句過去式、一句現在完成式
write.eg: She lost her key yesterday. She has lost her key, so she can't get in.

F5.4-first-conditional.goal: 說出「如果⋯⋯就會⋯⋯」這種有可能發生的事
F5.4-first-conditional.formZh: If ＋ 現在式，後面主句用 will／can ＋ 原形（if 裡面不能用 will）

speak.zh: 說如果明天下雨你會怎麼做
speak.eg: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

write.zh: 寫一句真的有可能發生的「如果⋯⋯就⋯⋯」
write.eg: If we leave now, we will catch the bus.

F5.5-relative-basic.goal: 用一句話補充說明「哪一個人、哪個東西、哪個地方」
F5.5-relative-basic.formZh: 名詞 ＋ who／which／that／where ＋ 補充說明（人用 who，物用 which）

speak.zh: 用 who 的子句描述一個人
speak.eg: He is the boy who won the race.

write.zh: 寫一句用 that 或 which 的話
write.eg: This is the book that I like best.

F5.6-reflexive-reference.goal: 說「他自己」時用對字，也別讓「他」指不清楚是誰
F5.6-reflexive-reference.formZh: 主詞和受詞是同一個人時用 -self；強調時也可放在名詞後面

speak.zh: 說一件你自己一個人完成的事
speak.eg: I made this cake by myself.

write.zh: 把一句「他」指不清楚的話改清楚
write.eg: Tom told Ben that Tom was late.

F6.1-tense-choice.goal: 寫一整段的時候，時態前後要一致
F6.1-tense-choice.formZh: 看整件事發生的時間軸來決定時態，不要只看某一個關鍵字

speak.zh: 說一個小故事，要有背景和主要事件
speak.eg: I was walking home when I saw my old teacher.

write.zh: 用過去式和現在完成式寫三句連貫的話
write.eg: We planted a tree last spring. It has grown a lot. Now it gives us shade.

F6.2-passive-process.goal: 當「誰做的」不重要時，把重點放在事情本身
F6.2-passive-process.formZh: be ＋ 動詞的過去分詞；真的要說做事者才加 by

speak.zh: 用被動語態說明一個步驟
speak.eg: The water is heated for ten minutes.

write.zh: 把主動句改寫成強調成品的被動句
write.eg: The bridge was built in 1998.

F6.3-future-forms.goal: 分清楚四種講未來的說法
F6.3-future-forms.formZh: 時刻表用現在式；已約好用現在進行式；有計畫用 going to；當下決定用 will

speak.zh: 說一個已經約好的安排，和一個計畫
speak.eg: I am meeting my friend at six. I am going to buy a gift.

write.zh: 寫一句時刻表的話，和一句預測
write.eg: The train leaves at seven. It will be cold tomorrow.

F6.4-expanded-noun-phrases.goal: 把一個東西描述得更精確
F6.4-expanded-noun-phrases.formZh: 冠詞 ＋ 依順序排的形容詞 ＋ 名詞 ＋ 後面補充說明

speak.zh: 用兩個修飾語描述一樣東西
speak.eg: It is a small blue notebook.

write.zh: 寫一個名詞後面帶補充說明的詞組
write.eg: the girl in the red jacket

F6.5-reporting-sources.goal: 說明這個資訊是從哪裡來的
F6.5-reporting-sources.formZh: According to ＋ 來源, 句子；或 某人 ＋ says／explains that ＋ 句子

speak.zh: 用 According to... 說一個資訊
speak.eg: According to the report, the school will open a new library.

write.zh: 寫一句清楚說明資料來源的話
write.eg: The teacher explained that the test will be next Friday.

F6.6-cohesion-basic.goal: 讓一整段話讀起來順、前後接得上
F6.6-cohesion-basic.formZh: 順序詞 ＋ 清楚的指涉 ＋ 適度重複關鍵字

speak.zh: 用轉折語連接兩個相反的想法
speak.eg: The plan is cheap; however, it is not safe.

write.zh: 用順序詞寫三句話描述一個流程
write.eg: First, we wash the rice. Then, we add water. Finally, we cook it.

F7.1-relative-advanced.goal: 用補充子句時，讓補充說明連到正確的對象
F7.1-relative-advanced.formZh: 限定用法不加逗號；補充用法要加逗號，且要緊接在被說明的詞後面

speak.zh: 用 whose 描述一個人
speak.eg: She is the student whose drawing won first prize.

write.zh: 寫一句有逗號的補充說明子句
write.eg: My uncle, who lives in Tainan, is a doctor.

F7.2-modal-deduction.goal: 用 must／may／might／can't 表達「有多確定」
F7.2-modal-deduction.formZh: 情態動詞 ＋ 原形；推測過去用 情態動詞 ＋ have ＋ 過去分詞

speak.zh: 用 might 做一個保留一點的猜測
speak.eg: She might be at the library.

write.zh: 寫一個有證據支持的強推論
write.eg: The lights are on, so someone must be home.

F7.3-register.goal: 看對象調整說話的正式程度
F7.3-register.formZh: 依對象決定用字、要不要縮寫、語氣強弱

speak.zh: 同一件事，分別用對朋友和對老師的說法各講一次
speak.eg: Can you send me the file? Could you please send me the file?

write.zh: 把一句口語的話改寫成報告用的說法
write.eg: The results indicate a clear improvement.

F7.4-reference-across-sentences.goal: 讓 it、they、this 清楚指到前面講過的東西
F7.4-reference-across-sentences.formZh: 代名詞要能明確對應到前面某個名詞；會混淆時就把名詞重講一次

speak.zh: 說明一段話裡的代名詞指的是什麼
speak.eg: In that sentence, it refers to the broken printer.

write.zh: 把指涉不清楚的句子改成清楚的說法
write.eg: The device broke. This failure caused a delay.

F7.5-punctuation.goal: 用標點把資訊分層，不要一路用逗號串到底
F7.5-punctuation.formZh: 冒號引出說明；分號連接兩個完整句；破折號和括號放補充資訊

speak.zh: 唸一句有冒號的話，並說明冒號帶出什麼
speak.eg: We need three things: paper, glue, and scissors.

write.zh: 用分號連接兩個關係密切的完整句
write.eg: It works; we agree.

F7.6-edit-naturalness.goal: 檢查句子除了文法對，是不是也講得自然
F7.6-edit-naturalness.formZh: 先看意思對不對，再看結構、用字搭配、語氣是否合適

speak.zh: 說明一句聽得懂但不自然的話，問題在哪裡
speak.eg: I very like it should be I really like it.

write.zh: 從意思、自然度和語氣三方面改寫一句話
write.eg: I would like to request more information.
